## Checklist

- [ ] My change is focused on one thing and has tests for any changed behaviour.
- [ ] I updated the README / types / docstrings where public behaviour changed.
- [ ] I added an entry under an "Unreleased" heading in `CHANGELOG.md` (if the repository has one).
- [ ] I did not add runtime dependencies (or I discussed it in an issue first).
- [ ] I did not bump the package version.
- [ ] No real API keys, provider keys, tokens or other secrets appear in code, tests, logs or screenshots.
